data.name: Variant Channeling - Magic
data.description: Heal - Creatures gain a +%1 channel bonus on caster level checks and concentration checks until the end of your next turn. Harm - All creatures must make concentration checks (DC = channel energy DC plus spell level) to use spells or spell-like abilities until the end of your next turn.|ChannelModifier
